spec.description:
Autex Lanes Baffle Peak is a battened-style acoustic wall system featuring a
distinctive 3D angled peak profile folded from 12mm Cube polyester felt.
Engineered with an integrated air gap behind each batten, Lanes Peak enhances
low-frequency sound absorption while transforming flat walls into sculptural
architectural features. It installs quickly using a dedicated mechanical
clipping system that eliminates the need for adhesives and ensures clean,
precise joins.

install:
Confirm wall substrate is plumb, flat, dry,
and structurally sound

Establish layout and set out vertical mounting lines
at 300mm centres

Fasten mounting channels or clips horizontally across studs
at recommended intervals using suitable screws

Snap folded Peak lane sections
securely onto the mounting clips from bottom to top without glue

Align
adjacent Peak panels to ensure clean, continuous ridge lines along joins

Trim
bottom or top perimeter edges with a track saw or sharp utility knife where
required
selection_checklist:
Confirm wall height to choose 2400mm
or 2700mm length (or custom up to 3600mm)

Calculate total width needed (each
lane is 300mm wide; 3 lanes per pack)

Confirm Peak profile is selected for
a 3D angled ridge design
Select colour from the Autex Cube palette

Verify
substrate framing centres for mounting clip attachment
limitations:
Indoor wall application only;
not for exterior cladding or wet areas

Do not use adhesives directly unless
advised by manufacturer, as clipping system provides the acoustic air gap
Batch-to-batch colour variation may occur due to fibre blending

retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Lanes Baffle Peak is a 300mm wide, folded 3D acoustic wall
batten system crafted from 12mm Cube polyester felt into an angled peak ridge
profile. Installed with a glue-free mechanical clipping system that maintains an
internal acoustic air gap, it delivers superior low-frequency and speech noise
control (NRC 0.80). Certified Group 1 fire rated and carbon neutral with
over 60% recycled PET, it provides a sculptural, easy-to-install wall feature
for commercial, education, and hospitality interiors.
